name: sistema-chatbot
description: Chatbot documental de WhatsApp administrable visualmente. Monorepo (ADR-001).

scripts.check: pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run lint && pnpm run format:check && pnpm run check:boundaries && pnpm run test && pnpm run build
scripts.db:migrate: pnpm --filter @sistema-chatbot/db run build && pnpm --filter @sistema-chatbot/db run migrate
scripts.db:types: pnpm --filter @sistema-chatbot/db run build && pnpm --filter @sistema-chatbot/db run types
scripts.db:types:verify: pnpm --filter @sistema-chatbot/db run build && pnpm --filter @sistema-chatbot/db run types:verify
